title: Certificates of Deposit: The Rate the Terms Fix for a Term, Rebuilt From the Certificate Record
content:
Each of Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit records an interest rate, but the rate that the certificate terms actually fix for a term can be rebuilt independently, and it is that rebuilt figure against which an early withdrawal penalty is measured. This page defines the figure.

## Definition

The rate the terms fix for a term is the tier's standard interest rate as it stood at the start of the term, plus the bonus points the term earned at its start. Where a rate recorded on the certificate disagrees with this figure, the recorded rate gives way: a penalty is measured against the rate the terms fix, and the tier setting that names the certificate's interest rate as the penalty rate is read as meaning this figure.

In the penalty calculation this figure stands in the rate's place. A penalty is thus the penalty basis times the rate the terms fix, taken over 100, times the number of penalty days, taken over the tier's day-count year, and rounded half-up to the cent.

## Rebuilding it

**The standard rate at the term's start** is recovered from the certificate itself: take the interest rate recorded on the certificate; subtract the tier's Jumbo Bonus points if the certificate's Jumbo Bonus marker is set; subtract the tier's Relationship Bonus points if its Relationship Bonus marker is set.

**The rate the terms fix** then starts again from that standard rate: the tier's Jumbo Bonus points are added back when the Jumbo Bonus marker is set, and the tier's Relationship Bonus points are added when the Relationship Bonus was in fact earned at the term's start. Neither bonus is stacked on the other: each contributes its points once, onto that one standard figure.

## What can make the two rates differ

| Relationship Bonus marker on the certificate | Relationship Bonus earned at the term's start | Rate the terms fix, compared with the recorded rate |
|---|---|---|
| Set | Yes | The same |
| Set | No | Lower by the tier's Relationship Bonus points |
| Not set | Yes | Higher by the tier's Relationship Bonus points |
| Not set | No | The same |

The Jumbo Bonus is taken out and put back on the same marker, so it never opens a gap by itself.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A certificate records a rate of 4.12 percent, with both bonus markers set; assume the tier's Jumbo Bonus is 0.10 points and its Relationship Bonus 0.15 points.

- Standard rate at the term's start: 4.12 less 0.10 less 0.15, that is 3.87 percent.
- If the Relationship Bonus was earned at the term's start: 3.87 plus 0.10 plus 0.15, that is 4.12 percent, matching the record.
- If it was not earned: 3.87 plus 0.10, that is 3.97 percent, and a penalty booked at 4.12 percent was booked at a rate other than the one the terms fix.
